**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly stated that Peter Finch was the spouse most associated with Vivien Leigh during the "Gone with the Wind" era. This is factually wrong, as Vivien Leigh was married to Laurence Olivier during that time (1940-1960), and her relationship with Peter Finch was a later extramarital partnership. This misunderstanding caused misdirection in subsequent steps with repeated searches and tasks aimed at validating incorrect assumptions instead of focusing on confirming the known fact that Laurence Olivier was her husband during the critical timeline. The Planner failed to verify authoritative data before asserting an incorrect association.
